oyer.m: A hearing in a civil case which is based on the content of a document, in which the plaintiff is required to produce the document.

oyes.m: Another spelling of oyez. oyez: hear ye.

oysterer.m: One who finds and sells oysters.

oysterers.m: More than one oysterer. oysterer: one who finds and sells oysters.

oysterman.m: A person who cultivates, harvests or sells oysters.

oystermen.m: More than one oysterman. oysterman: a person who cultivates, harvests or sells oysters.
